title: Arnaud Gallou
text:
Multidisciplinary problem solver with a scientific background and ongoing training in AI and Big Data at ENSEEIHT in Toulouse, France. Experienced in developing tools and reproducible analytical workflows in Python and R, with a strong focus on writing simple and maintanable code. Skilled in CI/CD, data wrangling, analysis, visualisation, and technical writing. I combine collaborative mindset and attention to details to deliver high-quality work.
Photo and outdoor enthusiast in my spare time who loves exploring remote places on skis, foot or by bike. When not in the wilderness, you can find me playing or listening to music (mostly classical, prog, metal, and blues), or struggling to make my own ultralight hiking gear for my next adventure.
